args.synopsis: You enter a space where the scent of old paper lingers in the air, drifting between towering walls of wooden shelves. At the heart of the room, you pause before a cleansing ritual basin carved from black basalt, its presence grounding the space. You circle the stone, feeling the weight of the volcanic island before following the perimeter. Finally, you reach the counter at the back, leaving with a fragrance that echoes the quiet stillness of the room.
args.line: Where the library ends, the scent begins, flowing through stone and wood to reveal a new path.
args.title: The Scented Library
why: The shelves create a sense of immersion within an endless collection of bottled memories.
The central basin forces an immediate shift in focus, grounding you in a physical experience of purification.
Circling the central piece creates a natural, unhurried flow that respects the meditative nature of the space.
The back counter offers a secluded conclusion to your exploration, tucked away from the main path.

### The Scented Library
A sanctuary of basalt and aromatic reflection in Jeju.

You enter a space where the scent of old paper lingers in the air, drifting between towering walls of wooden shelves. At the heart of the room, you pause before a cleansing ritual basin carved from black basalt, its presence grounding the space. You circle the stone, feeling the weight of the volcanic island before following the perimeter. Finally, you reach the counter at the back, leaving with a fragrance that echoes the quiet stillness of the room.
